headline: AUM hand Lee their first defeat of the season
dek: Lee had won three and drawn two without a defeat before Saturday, and then lost at AUM. Trevecca were held at Montevallo the same evening, so UAH, who have conceded twice in four matches, are now the only side in the conference still winning every match they play.
displaced_by: The first Saturday of conference play: Lee's first defeat, at AUM

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The scoring at the top is still shared: UAH's twelve goals have come from eight different players.

wire.line: UAH and Trevecca, both still unbeaten, meet each other in the first week of conference play.

next_match.line: West Alabama are still without a win; Tuskegee have already won at Union.
